1. What is CICADA Sentinel? (In Simple Words)

Imagine you run a large company with hundreds of production servers. You need to know if your servers are healthy (CPU, Memory, Disk, Network speed) and detect cyberattacks or crashes before they happen.

Traditionally, companies install monitoring tools like Datadog or Prometheus. But these tools have a huge privacy flaw: they suck up entire log files and send them to a third-party cloud. If an engineer accidentally printed a user's password, credit card number, or private API key into a log file, that confidential data is leaked to the outside world.

The CICADA Sentinel Solution: We created an intelligent monitoring system where raw logs NEVER leave the customer's private computer. A local AI Guardian inspects every metric, filters out all passwords and confidential data, signs the safe numbers with cryptographic SHA-256 signatures, and transmits only clean mathematical performance telemetry to the cloud dashboard.

2. The Two-Tier Architecture (How It Works Step-by-Step)

Our system is divided into two decoupled tiers to guarantee zero-trust privacy:

1
Tier 1: Local Edge Collector (Runs on Customer Server)
A lightweight Python daemon runs directly on the local machine. It reads CPU, RAM, Disk, and Latency using native psutil system calls. It monitors local application logs without ever sending them out.
2
The Local AI Privacy Guardian (The Pre-Egress Firewall)
Before anything leaves the computer, our AI Privacy Guardian inspects the payload. It runs regex allow-lists, scans for high-entropy secrets (passwords and API keys), and checks for fake canary tokens. If a secret is detected, transmission is immediately blocked locally!
3
Cryptographic Envelope Signing & SQLite Outbox
The approved metadata is hashed with SHA-256 and chained to the previous transmission (like a blockchain block). It is HMAC-signed with the tenant's secret key and saved in a local SQLite outbox. If the internet goes down, the outbox holds the data and safely retries later.
4
Tier 2: Central SaaS Cloud Platform (Node.js & MongoDB Atlas)
The SaaS cloud receives the signed envelope, verifies the cryptographic signature, checks sequence numbers to prevent duplicate payloads, stores the records in MongoDB Atlas, and streams live metrics to the NOC dashboard via WebSockets.
5
AIOps Correlation & Reversible Remediation
The cloud AI engine analyzes the telemetry. If CPU, RAM, and Latency spike at the same time, it groups them into a single incident, shows an explainable root cause, and offers an operator 1-click remediation with an automated 60-second safety rollback timer.

4. Core Algorithms & Mathematical Engines (Made Simple)

Algorithm 1: Multivariate Z-Score Anomaly Detection

Z = (Current_Value - Mean) / Standard_Deviation

How it works: The system remembers the normal baseline for CPU, RAM, Disk, and Latency over the last 30 readings. When a sudden spike occurs, it calculates the Z-Score. If |Z| > 2.5, it mathematically knows this is an abnormal event and flags an anomaly immediately.

Algorithm 2: Dynamic Sampling with Hysteresis (75% Cost Reduction)

How it works: Transmitting data continuously to the cloud costs bandwidth and money. When the system is healthy, it sends a tiny 1-line Heartbeat summary, saving 75% bandwidth. When an anomaly is detected, it instantly switches to Anomaly Burst mode (sending detailed 2-second samples). It requires 6 healthy samples in a row before cooling down, preventing alert bouncing.

Algorithm 3: Shannon Entropy Secret Detection

H(X) = - ∑ [ P(character) × log2(P(character)) ]

How it works: Normal English text has low randomness (entropy around 2.0 - 3.5). Passwords, RSA private keys, and API tokens look like random gibberish (high entropy > 4.5). The Privacy Guardian calculates the Shannon entropy of text strings. If it detects high entropy, it blocks the payload before it can leave!

Algorithm 4: Blockchain-Style Cryptographic Hash Chaining

Block_Hash = SHA256( Previous_Block_Hash + Current_Payload_Hash + Sequence_Number )

How it works: Every outgoing telemetry envelope is cryptographically linked to the previous one. If a hacker intercepts the transmission and changes even 1 single byte, the hash chain breaks instantly, alerting the administrator of tampering.

5. The 8 Innovation Features (Beyond Standard Monitoring)

Standard AIOps tools only detect crashes. CICADA Sentinel introduces 8 self-protecting innovations that protect the customer's data and automatically heal the system:

#1 AI Privacy Guardian
An intelligent pre-transmission firewall that inspects all outgoing payloads. It analyzes text randomness (Shannon Entropy) and verifies strict allow-lists so secrets never leave the private machine.
MongoDB Atlas: privacy_guardians
#2 Canary Honeytokens
Fake credentials (e.g., CANARY-SECRET-92831) planted in test environments as deception traps. If an attacker or rogue script touches a canary, the system immediately isolates the server and halts transmission.
MongoDB Atlas: honeytokens
#3 Adaptive Dynamic Privacy
Data is categorized into 4 tiers: Public, Internal, Confidential, and Critical. When security threat levels rise from Normal to Critical, the system automatically tightens its redaction and drops non-essential metadata.
MongoDB Atlas: adaptive_policies
#4 Tamper Egress Ledger
An immutable, verifiable audit record linking every transmission using SHA-256 HMAC chains. If an attacker modifies telemetry in transit, the ledger detects the mismatch in real time.
MongoDB Atlas: tamper_ledgers
#5 Collector Fingerprinting
Monitors collector behavior: transmission frequency, payload size, and TLS certificates. If an edge agent starts behaving strangely (like burst transfers at 2 AM), it is quarantined via mTLS revocation.
MongoDB Atlas: collector_fingerprints
#6 Attack Correlation Graph
Instead of drowning engineers in 50 separate alerts, the AI engine correlates disjoint events (failed logins + CPU spike + outbound burst) into a single unified attack story mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
MongoDB Atlas: attack_graphs
#7 Policy Simulator Sandbox
Allows administrators to test new filtering rules on historical data before pushing them live. It predicts exactly how many records will be blocked and how much bandwidth will be saved.
MongoDB Atlas: policy_simulators
#8 Reversible Remediation
Provides human-approved remediation actions (rotate token, isolate node, restore policy). Every action has an automatic 60-second safety countdown timer that rolls back if metrics do not improve!
MongoDB Atlas: remediations

6. MongoDB Atlas Database Integration

All data is stored in the user's cloud MongoDB Atlas cluster (cluster0.ylwjczh.mongodb.net) under database cicada_sentinel:

  • Core Observability Collections: collectors, telemetries, egressproofs, alerts, incidents.
  • 8 Innovation Collections: privacy_guardians, honeytokens, adaptive_policies, tamper_ledgers, collector_fingerprints, attack_graphs, policy_simulators, remediations.
  • Live Synchronous Updates: Whenever a button is clicked in the dashboard (e.g. trigger canary, simulate rogue collector, approve fix), MongoDB Atlas is updated in real time!
